semiconductor_relevance: High — Niching Industrial Corp. specializes in adhesive materials that are critical for semiconductor packaging and assembly processes.
summary: Niching Industrial Corp. is a Taiwan-based provider of advanced adhesive solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include thermal and conductive adhesives, as well as a range of materials for testing and assembly in semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Thermal and conductive adhesives for semiconductor applications
Chip bonding resins and dicing solutions
Wire bonding capillaries and chip transport trays

regional_presence.Taiwan: Niching Industrial Corp. is based in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor and high-tech industries.
